features.name: Deferral Posting Controls
features.description: Ability to control when and by whom deferred income and expenses can be posted to the general ledger. Company-wide rules can be set up via general ledger setup to define the window for when deferral postings are allowed.

features.name: User-Level Deferral Posting Overrides
features.description: Individual users can be given permission to post deferrals outside the company-wide window through user setup. This allows specific users like Carlos to post deferrals into the future beyond the standard posting period.
caveats: User-level override only applies to specific users as configured

features.name: Deferral Templates
features.description: Templates that define how income or expenses should be deferred across future accounting periods. The example shows a deferral template set up to capture income in a straight line over six accounting periods.
